# v1-golden.txt: wire format contract v1 test vectors (big-endian). Format: <name> <hex of whole frame: 36-byte header + payload>.
# Header (36 B): magic 544b5630 | kind 1 | flags 00 | reserved 0000 | payload length u32 | run id u64 0102030405060708 | incarnation u32 00000007 | tx u64 | msg u32.
# str = u16 length + bytes.
# Protocol v1 differs from v0 only in the HELLO version (0001) and in the end of every VERDICT payload (below). The magic stays 544b5630
# ('TKV0') and the 36-byte header is unchanged: the bit that says more rules matched (08) is in the cut flags byte of the VERDICT payload.
# The names that start with bad_ are frames that the receiving side must refuse; every other frame is valid.
# hello (kind 01, tx 0, msg 0; payload 111 B): version 0001 | pid 00001092 | nonce 000102..0f | run id 0102030405060708 | incarnation 00000007 | go 0008 'go1.27.2' | coraza 0006 'v3.8.1' | sum 0007 'h1:abc=' | rules sha256 a0..bf (32 B) | body limit 00100000 | memory limit 0000000010000000 | GOMAXPROCS 0002 | tx limit 0004 | queue 0011
hello 544b5630010000000000006f010203040506070800000007000000000000000000000000000100001092000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f0102030405060708000000070008676f312e32372e32000676332e382e31000768313a6162633da0a1a2a3a4a5a6a7a8a9aaabacadaeafb0b1b2b3b4b5b6b7b8b9babbbcbdbebf001000000000000010000000000200040011
# tx_begin (kind 10, tx 0x10, msg 1; payload 129 B): client 0009 '127.0.0.1' | port 9c40 | server 0009 '127.0.0.1' | port 1f90 | method 0004 'POST' | URI 0006 '/a?q=1' | proto 0008 'HTTP/1.1' | declared body len u64 5 | header count 0002 | 0004 'Host' 000c 'example.test' | 000c 'Content-Type' 0021 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
tx_begin 
# tx_begin_cut: the tx_begin above with flags 01 (the body goes on past the declared bytes; only TX_BEGIN may carry it).

# tx_end (kind 16, tx 0x10, msg 7; payload 1 B): reason 01 (complete)
tx_end 544b5630160000000000000101020304050607080000000700000000000000100000000701
# A VERDICT ends with the matched rules: count u8 (0..16) | count x rule id i64 (each > 0) | severity u8 (0..7, ff none) | score i32 (-1 none, 0 and up a score; any other negative is refused).
# The flag bit3 (08) says that more rules matched than the 16 listed; it needs count 16. Only phases 1 and 2 may carry rules, a severity or a score: phases 3 and 4 carry 00 | ff | ffffffff.
# Nothing to carry is written 00 | ff | ffffffff.
# verdict_continue (kind 20, tx 0x10, msg 1; payload 24 B): phase 01 | decision 00 (continue) | cut flags 00 | reserved 00 | rule id i64 0 | status 0000 | action 0000 (empty) | data 0000 (empty) | rules 00 | severity ff | score ffffffff
verdict_continue 544b5630200000000000001801020304050607080000000700000000000000100000000101000000000000000000000000000000000000ffffffffff
